summary: Full re-test of RX Tech B2B marketplace after theme change (OrlaFarma palette: orange #F08C47, teal #7DC4B6, cream #FCF6E6) and demo-only seeding policy. Backend: 32/32 pytest tests passed (100%) including new TestDemoSeed (4 orders / 4 payments / 8 shortbook / 2 returns for demo@rxtech.com) and TestFreshUserEmpty (0 everything for non-demo) suites. Frontend: end-to-end verified on mobile viewport (390x844) for BOTH demo and fresh users. Demo login → home shows ₹27.6K today's orders, ₹42.3K payment due (ABC Pharma), AI Insights with 7 SKUs, 3 deliveries; Orders tab shows ORD-2340/2341/2342/2338; Payments tab shows INV-12934/12891/12702/12660. Fresh user login → home shows ₹0/0 orders, ₹0 payment due, 0 SKUs; Orders tab shows 'No orders yet'; Payments tab shows 'No payments here'. Theme verified: teal R + orange X logo, orange Continue button, cream input backgrounds, orange (#F08C47) active bottom-tab color confirmed. Vendor catalog (5 distributors) loads for all users.
action_items: (Cosmetic, non-blocking) Console still shows 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warning from a third-party / older RN component — same as iteration 1.
(Optional) Consider adding tabBarTestID to each Tabs.Screen entry in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx for more robust e2e tab navigation.
critical_code_review_comments: Theme tokens correctly centralised in /app/frontend/src/theme.ts and consumed via colors.primary / colors.accent / colors.surface — palette change propagated to all screens without hard-coded colors.
Backend seed logic gated cleanly on DEMO_EMAIL constant ('demo@rxtech.com'); seed_user_data() called only inside verify-otp for that email (server.py L326).
Distributors + products still seeded globally on startup (server.py L196) and remain available to all users — correct.
All existing endpoints (auth, dashboard, cart, orders, payments, returns, shortbook) untouched and continue to pass for both demo and fresh users.
server.py is at ~725 lines — still under threshold but consider modular split (auth/catalog/cart/orders routers) on next feature addition.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_rxtech_backend.py (rewritten to cover demo-vs-fresh seeding split + retain full CRUD coverage)

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical flows verified (demo seeded + fresh empty)

seed_data_creation: Demo user (demo@rxtech.com) is auto-seeded by backend on first verify-otp. Fresh users created per test run (fresh+<timestamp>@test.com) — start with empty collections by design.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Selectors confirmed: email-input, email-continue-btn, verify-otp-btn (NOT 'otp-verify'), otp-input-{0..5}, onb-name, onb-phone, onb-shop, onb-gst, onb-address, onb-submit (button label is 'Complete Setup', NOT 'Finish'). OTP is appended to URL as ?devOtp=NNNNNN after /api/auth/send-otp redirect. For OTP entry use page.evaluate to focus inputs[0] then page.keyboard.type(otp) then click verify-otp-btn. Bottom tabs are NOT tagged with testID — navigate via direct URL (/home, /vendors, /orders, /payments, /more). Theme verification: RGB(240,140,71)=orange, RGB(125,196,182)=teal, RGB(252,246,230)=cream. Demo dashboard expected values: today_orders=₹27.6K/3 orders, payment_due=₹42.3K ABC Pharma, ai_insights sku_count=7 (or 8 depending on prior shortbook-order tests), deliveries=3.
rca_of_issue: No bugs. Seed gating verified: demo email triggers seed_user_data() exactly once (idempotent via orders count check); non-demo emails skip the seed entirely. Theme change is purely token-level so all screens pick up new colors automatically. End-to-end flow (signup → onboard → home → tabs → place order) tested for both demo and fresh paths successfully.
